accepted.sentence: In humid growing regions, black leaf streak can defoliate plantations, so growers remove infected leaves and use disease-management measures.
Where Fusarium wilt has entered a field, its persistent soilborne fungus can make replanting with susceptible varieties impractical for many years.
Commercial farms often retain one vigorous basal shoot after harvest to replace the spent stem and support the next crop cycle.
In the Philippines, a sweet-savory condiment made from the fruit is commonly used as an alternative to tomato ketchup.
The corm-boring weevil weakens plants by tunneling into underground tissues, so growers use clean planting material to limit its spread.
On some tropical farms, leguminous cover crops grow between rows, protecting bare soil while adding nitrogen through biological fixation.
Wild relatives may rely on bats for nighttime pollination, unlike many cultivated forms that produce fruit without fertilization.
At export ports, inspectors check maturity and surface condition before consignments are approved for shipment to overseas markets.
